title: Technology-enabled Social Network Intervention to Increase Live Donor Kidney Transplantation
official: Increasing Live Donor Kidney Transplantation Through Video-based Education and Mobile Communication
summary: The study is a 2-arm randomized controlled trial among patients referred for kidney transplant evaluation at a single transplant center to compare the effects of a digital-analog intervention to increase living-donor kidney transplant access (KT-CONNECT) versus usual care. Following consent and baseline assessment, participants are randomized with equal allocation to 2 treatment arms: the KT-CONNECT intervention or Usual Care

interventions.name: Digital education outreach intervention for kidney transplant access and human guide
Digital education outreach intervention for kidney transplant access only (unguided)

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* referred to the transplant center for a kidney transplant
* aged 18 years and older
* speaks English

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previously exposed to any component of the intervention
* Listed for a kidney transplant at another center (multilisted)
* Seeking multiorgan transplantation
